subject: general
question: Burhi dihing is a tributary of which of the following rivers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Brahmaputra.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Dihing or Burhi Dihing is a large tributary, about** 380 kilometres long, of the Brahmaputra River in Upper Assam in northeastern India.**
 
• Brahmaputra originates under the name of Siang or Dihang, from the 
 
• Angsi glacier__ of the Kailash range near the Mansarovar lake.
 
• It enters India west of Sadiya town in Arunachal Pradesh. 
 
• Tributaries: Dibang, Lohit, Siang, Burhi Dihing, Tista, and Dhansari.
 
• It is known as Tsangpo in Tibet and Yarlung Zangbo in China. 
 
• The river crosses Assam below Dhubri and enters Bangladesh where the river is known as Jamuna and it flows for 337 km.
 
• It is a perennial river and has several peculiar characteristics due to its geography and prevailing climatic conditions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Tributaries from the left bank are: 

 
 
• Lhasa River, Nyang River, Parlung Zangbo, Lohit River, Dhansiri River and Kolong River
 
 
 
• Tributaries from the right bank​ are:
 
 
• ​Kameng, Manas, Beki, Raidak, Jaldhaka, Teesta and Subansiri River
